name: Sub Rose
source:
Long ago on the continent of Thelemite there was a great nation called Lavius. 
But a great war had divided the nation, creating new Nordia, while Lavius became SubNear. 
The new nations failed to coexist peacefully, and war raged. 

Four hundred years of war between Nordia and SubNear have raged. 
Now frictions are tenderly smoothed and the two nations begin 
a peaceful relationship for the first time... 12 years have passed since 
the union of its monarchs, thanks to the bold efforts of Queen Macarena 
of SubNear proposed to throw back the curtain on the history of 
all nations... and now a daughter is born, an heiress who could change history... 

Is she a god or a human? 
Will the true will of humanity succeed? 
Much will be revealed about the past of Lavius. 

All answers lay below the rose. 

An ADV Romance.

[From [URL=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE085728.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，特勒邁特大陸上有一個強大的國家，名叫拉維烏斯。
然而，一場大戰使國家分裂，新的諾迪亞就此誕生，而拉維烏斯則變成了薩布尼爾。
這兩個新國家未能和平共處，戰火不斷。

諾迪亞與薩布尼爾之間的戰爭持續了四百年。
如今，雙方小心彌合紛爭，第一次開始和平往來……兩國君主走到一起，至今已有十二年。這一切離不開薩布尼爾女王瑪卡蕾娜的大膽推動。她提出揭開各國歷史的帷幕……如今，一個女兒誕生了，一位可能改變歷史的女繼承人……

她是神，還是人？
人類真正的意志能否實現？
拉維烏斯過去的許多秘密將被揭示。

所有答案，都藏在玫瑰之下。

一款戀愛冒險遊戲。

［摘自[URL=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE085728.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
